PLAN "12-Week Resistance Training Plan for insulin sensitivity (PCOS) - Start 2026-06-01"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Insulin sensitivity improvement via progressive resistance training"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full-body foundation A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Full-body foundation B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 3 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Stability and movement review":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          contralateral_step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 3 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive overload A (INTENSITY UP)":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Tuesday cardio 25m "Steady-state cardio for fat loss with HIIT blocks":
        cardio:
          modality: walking
          duration: 25 minutes
          intensity: moderate
        notes: "Add 2x20s near-max effort after 15 minutes if energy availability allows"
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Push intensity boost (Phase 2)":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x6..10 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Core & Mobility":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..40 seconds each side
          pallof_press 3x10..12 each side
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 3 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Volume build with HIIT integration":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up_assisted 4x4..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        HIIT_BLOCK:
          - duration 6 minutes
          - structure: "30s hard / 60s easy" x6
          - modality: cycling or rowing
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Dedicated upper/lower split with HIIT microbursts":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        HIIT_BLOCK:
          - duration 4 minutes
          - structure: "20s hard / 40s easy" x6
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Conditioning microburst with HIIT focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        HIIT_BLOCK:
          - duration 6 minutes
          - structure: "45s hard / 45s easy" x6
          - modality: treadmill running or cycling
        cooldown:
          arm_stretch 3 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peak strength and sustainability":
        warmup:
          walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 5x3..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        HIIT_BLOCK:
          - duration 8 minutes
          - structure: "20s hard / 40s easy" x8
          - modality: cycling or rowing
        cooldown:
          full_body_mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Hypertrophy maintenance with HIIT tweaks":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        HIIT_BLOCK:
          - duration 6 minutes
          - structure: "30s hard / 60s easy" x6
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 55m "Active recovery and mobility with light HIIT":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..15 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x20..40 seconds rpe 6
        HIIT_BLOCK:
          - duration 4 minutes
          - structure: "15s hard / 45s easy" x8
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 5 minutes

  NUTRITION_PHASE "Glycaemic control focus (PCOS)"
  GOALS
    - Support insulin sensitivity
    - Stable energy, avoid hypoglycemia/under-fuelling
    - Aggressive caloric deficit only if clinician approves; maintain energy availability for training
  DAILY_MACROS
    target_calorie_range:
      min 1500
      max 1800
    macronutrient_distribution:
      protein 1.8..2.2 g_per_kg_bodyweight
      fat 0.6..1.0 g_per_kg_bodyweight
      carbohydrates rest_of_calories
  MEAL_PATTERNS
    - meal_frequency: "3 main meals + 1-2 snacks"
    - protein_focus_per_meal: true
    - fiber_target: "at least 25g per day"
  NUTRIENT_DOCUS
    - emphasize: "vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, healthy fats"
    - fiber_sources: "vegetables, legumes, whole grains, fruits"
    - glycemic_load_aware: true
  TIMING
    - preworkout_snack: "protein + carbohydrate within 2 hours before training if training in same day"
    - postworkout: "protein + carbohydrate within 2 hours after training"
  HYDRATION
    - daily_target_ml: "30-35 ml_per_kg_bodyweight"
  SUPPLEMENT_CONSIDERATIONS
    - vitamin_d: "consider 1000-2000 IU daily if deficient or low sun exposure"
    - omega_3: "2-3 g/day combined EPA+DHA if dietary intake low"
    - magnesium: "300-400 mg in evening if deficient or during stress"
  MONITORING
    - track_glycaemic_control: true
    - HbA1c_recheck: "as advised by clinician, typically every 3-6 months"
  IMPLEMENTATION
    - adjust_calories: "only if clinician approves; if aggressive deficit, reassess weekly with monitoring"
    - carbohydrate_modulation: "prioritize low_glycemic_index carbs, paired with protein/fat to modulate postprandial glucose"
  START_DATE_NUTRITION: "2026-06-01"

CARDIO_PLAN
  PLAN_SUMMARY
    - goal: "accelerate weight loss while preserving lean mass"
    - approach: "integrate cardio 2-3 sessions/week, progressively increasing duration; HIIT integrated with caution"
  SCHEDULE
    Phase1:
      WEEK 1-4:
        - DAY Tuesday: "Steady-state cardio" 25 minutes walking
        - DAY Friday: "Intervals" 20 minutes: 1 min brisk walk / 1 min moderate jog x8
    Phase2:
      WEEK 5-8:
        - DAY Tuesday: "Steady-state cardio" 30 minutes cycling or brisk walking
        - DAY Thursday: "Intervals" 22 minutes: 1 min fast / 1 min easy x8
    Phase3:
      WEEK 9-12:
        - DAY Tuesday: "Fasted or fed-state cardio" 30-35 minutes walking or cycling
        - DAY Friday: "Intervals" 24 minutes: 1 min hard / 1 min easy x8
  MODALITIES:
    - walking, cycling
  INTENSITY_GUIDANCE:
    - RPE target: 5-7 out of 10 during steady-state
  NOTES:
    - HIIT additions: include daily HIIT blocks only if energy availability is proven and clinician approves; otherwise keep to maximum 3 sessions/week
    - avoid excessive cardio that could trigger under-fueling
    - ensure energy availability around training days

ONE_RM_TEST
  DESCRIPTION: "Optional end-of-phase-3 1RM assessment to gauge maximal strength progress"
  TIMING: "Consider after Week 9 or Week 12 depending on readiness and clinician guidance"
  PROTOCOL_SUGGESTION:
    - select 2-3 core lifts to test: squat, bench_press, deadlift or pull_up if proficient
    - perform: 1 set of warm-up reps, then estimate 1RM with 4-6RM attempts following standard progression
  SAFETY_FLAGS:
    - ensure proper form and a spotter as needed
    - avoid high-volume sessions on same day as test
    - revert to submax loads if technique compromised
